# checkmk_aux_tag (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve information about a CheckMK auxiliary tag.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    checkmk = {
      source = "N3moAhead/checkmk"
    }
  }
}

provider "checkmk" {
  url      = "http://localhost:5000/test"
  username = "automation"
  password = "your-secret-here"
}

# Look up an auxiliary tag by ID
data "checkmk_aux_tag" "example" {
  aux_tag_id = "production"
}

output "tag_title" {
  value = data.checkmk_aux_tag.example.title
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the auxiliary tag.

### Read-Only

- `help` (String) Help text describing the auxiliary tag.
- `title` (String) Human-readable title for the auxiliary tag.
- `topic` (String) Topic for grouping auxiliary tags in the UI.
